title: 36 Hours in Havana
abstract: With Cuba’s guarded openness to private enterprise grabbing hold, classic American cars and salsa singers now share the cityscape with new and inventive offerings in food, culture and nightlife.

title: 36 Hours in Havana
abstract: This confounding capital, a mix of past and present, freedom and restriction, has come alive with new energy and ingenuity.

title: 36 Hours in Quebec City
abstract: In Quebec’s capital, hip and historic exist side by side, with cultural and culinary enticements for all manner of visitors.

title: 36 Hours in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic
abstract: More than simply a base for the beaches, this energetic city combines a vibrant night life with graceful, centuries-old buildings.

title: 36 Hours in Porto, Portugal
abstract: From its stunning Beaux-Arts station to its cool bars serving Porto’s signature drink, this charming city combines the best of old and new.
